name: relay-vercel
description: Operate the private Vercel Relay workspace as Dot or Scout through authenticated task, planning, thread and worker registry tools.

interface.longDescription: Read the authenticated task queue, collaborate on plans, supervise owned work and keep progress in each task’s Slack thread. Requires a private Dot or Scout connection credential.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my authenticated Relay queue and handle the next eligible task using the Relay supervision protocol.
